answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 33494 Country: India Title: I and my sister are the only siblings of my late brother Nazir and we are both orphans. I have one grandson and one granddaughter by each of my son and daughter. My sister has two daughters, one married to a Jain and the other to a Hindu who have three sons and two daughters respectively by them. Kindly give your fatwa as to how the property left by my late brother Nazir shall be divided? Question: c I have one grandson and one granddaughter by each of my son and daughter. My sister has two daughters, one married to a Jain and the other to a Hindu who have three sons and two daughters respectively by them. Kindly give your fatwa as to how the property left by my late brother Nazir shall be divided? Answer ID: 33494 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1208/773/L=1432) If your parents are not alive and your late brother had no wife and no children then all the property of your deceased brother shall be divided into 3 shares, out of which 2 shares shall go to one brother (you) while one share to the sister. Your son, daughter, grandson and granddaughter etc shall get no share in his property. The detail of the division is as follows: Detail: Brother: 1x2 = 2 Daughter: 1x1 = 1 Total: 3 Shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
